Class ObsSpec

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.ObsSpec
public final class ObsSpec extends Object
Shapes of everything the networks consume.

The actor sees only pixel-derived data (two masks plus statistics of those masks) and a short vector of things a player knows about their own body. It is never given distance, reach, an in-reach flag or the opponent's position. The critic additionally gets ground truth, but it only exists during training.

    • SC_OPP_CHARGE

      public static final int SC_OPP_CHARGE
      How far back the opponent's sword is, as far as can be told from the last time its arm was seen to swing: 0 just after a swing, 1 once a sword would be back (twelve and a half ticks), and 1 if it has not been seen to swing. A player in a real fight sees every swing of the other's arm, misses too, and judges the distance by it: out of reach while that sword is back, in again while it is not. Since 18 October; see BodyState.noteOpponentSwing.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • SC_STYLE_AWAY

      public static final int SC_STYLE_AWAY
      What this opponent has been doing over the last three seconds or so, as running averages kept by BodyState and started afresh with every fight: how fast it has been moving away from the fighter, how much of the time it has stood still at the edge of the reach, and how far off it has been (an eighth of the blocks). The network sees one moment; these tell an opponent that waits at the edge and jumps in on its own clock from one that walks in. Since 20 October.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

      public static void deriveStats(float[] stats)
